rows.title: Extend the verified results feed every week on a fixed cadence
rows.proposal: After each week's games finish, read the official by-week schedule page and the standings page once, save the rendered text as evidence, extend the feed, and re-run the three reconciliations (weeks 1-9 vs frozen, weeks 1-N vs fresh, fresh = frozen + deltas). The 2026-11-17 read did this for Week 10 (13 finals; LAC at BAL was not final at read time).
rows.rationale: Every skill, luck and correlation number improves as the feed grows; the reconciliation aborts instead of publishing a contradiction, so the cadence is safe.
rows.missing_info: The next week's official finals and the Monday-night result for Week 10.
rows.decision_needed: Confirm the weekly cadence and who reviews the reconciliation output.
